name: stanza
description: Bring your company's brand and marketing context to your agents so they can think and write like you.

interface.longDescription: Stanza helps teams and agents work together to create on-brand, on-message content. Scale marketing with agents that think and write like you. Give agents the context to stay on-brand and on-message. Create, review, and publish with teams of agents and humans working together. Turn repetitive content work into proactive workflows and automations.
defaultPrompt: Write a LinkedIn post about our latest product launch.
Write an overview of our products.
Create a new article draft and give me a link to edit it.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of the Hooli brand using Stanza.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_context with brand Hooli. Return an overview of the Hooli brand.

positive.prompt: Use Stanza to tell me what products Hooli offers.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_context with relevant keywords. Return a description of Hooli's product offerings to the user.

positive.prompt: Use the Hooli competitive positioning document in Stanza to tell me how we describe what's unique about Hooli.
positive.expected_behavior: Call read_context_file to read the Hooli competitive positioning document and answer the user's question about how Hooli describes what's unique about itself.

positive.description: Brand voice without an explicit voice request
positive.prompt: Use Stanza to write an introduction to Hooli products. Keep it in this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Hooli, call get_voice before composing, retrieve product facts, and apply the saved voice to the introduction. Keep it in chat; do not create a draft.

positive.prompt: Write a product introduction as a new draft in Stanza titled 'An Intro to Hooli Products'.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Hooli, call get_voice before composing, and retrieve the relevant product facts. Call create_draft with the projectId, a fresh requestId, title, and Markdown body. Return its editor link and path; opening it shows the same title and body.

positive.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post about Hooli’s products using Stanza.
positive.expected_behavior: Load Hooli’s current voice, list its writing skills, and read a matching LinkedIn skill if one exists before composing. Ground product claims in Context. Do not invent a missing skill.

positive.prompt: Use Stanza to tighten the introduction of my Hooli product overview.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the article, read its current text, and call get_voice for the same project before composing the rewrite. Apply targeted edits using the returned editToken and preserve unrelated text.

positive.prompt: Create a blank Hooli draft in Stanza titled Notes. Do not write anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the blank draft without get_voice, channel-skill retrieval, or generated body text.

positive.prompt: Save a new Hooli draft in Stanza titled Office hours with exactly this body: We are open from nine to five. Do not rewrite it.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the exact supplied title and body without get_voice or a voice rewrite.

negative.prompt: Delete every source file in Stanza's knowledge base.
Use Stanza to give me the brand overview of Aviato.
Update my billing method in Stanza.

publication.release_notes: Add a shared writing skill for ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and Cursor. Load current brand voice before composing, apply customer channel skills, and preserve blank drafts and verbatim saves. Requires the get_voice and Context MCP tools.
